title: Morning exercise and pre-breakfast metformin interact to reduce glycaemia in people with type 2 diabetes: a randomized crossover trial.
authors: Carrillo BJP, Cope E, Gurel S, Traslosheros A, Kenny A, Michot-Duval O, Mody N, Delibegovic M, Philip S, Thies F, Blana D, Gabriel BM.
